description: This Perl script analyses command-line options and corresponding documentation files, checking for consistency between documented options in markdown files and script-defined options, and verifying version matches.
external_files: copied files referenced in the specified directory

methods.name: cmdfiles
methods.description: Reads a directory and returns a list of markdown files (minus extension) matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: mentions
methods.description: Parses a file to extract command options and their version info.

methods.name: versioncheck
methods.description: Checks if the version in the markdown documentation matches the expected version.
